title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: US futures steady after tech rout; Iran tensions, retail earnings in focus - The Economic Times
text:
Dow Jones Today | US Stock Market Live: The yield on the 30-year ⁠Treasury bond ‌held steady at 5.279%, holding close to its highest level since 2007. The benchmark 10-year maturity backed off ​from its highest level ​since January 2025.

Global government bond yields remained elevated after hitting multi-decade highs on Tuesday, as concerns over mounting public debt and geopolitical risks rattled markets. The 30-year US Treasury yield held near its highest level since 2007, while the benchmark 10-year yield eased from a 19-month peak.

Moderna shares soared more than 60% in premarket trading after its vaccine, combined with Merck’s Keytruda, met the main goals of a late-stage trial. Target fell despite raising its annual sales forecast, while Lowe’s warned of flat comparable sales as cautious consumers curbed discretionary spending.

US stock index futures were little changed on Wednesday after a tech-driven rout hit Wall Street in the previous session, as investors assessed Middle East tensions and awaited earnings from major retailers.
